title: [MCP] Prepare Data Query Tools for billing
summary: Data Query Tools for MCP are now marked billable with a pricing acknowledgement requirement before activation. When imported, users are prompted to confirm pricing; headless imports default to disabled.
key_points: Data Query Tools are now billable and need a pricing acknowledgement before activation
A reusable MCP billing confirmation page is added for billable server features
A JSON import that requests Data Query Tools shows the prompt in GUI sessions; answering No, or importing headless, leaves it disabled
Upgrade resets existing Data Query Tools opt-ins, and the MCP capability is changed to Microsoft billed
A learn-more link to the pricing and terms is added
quote: mark Data Query Tools as billable and require pricing acknowledgement before activation
